at yde.explanation: "At yde" means "to provide" or "to perform", for help, support or effort that you offer: yde støtte (provide support), yde en indsats (make an effort).

sentence.da: Kommunen skal **yde** hjælp til familier i nød.
sentence.en: The municipality must provide help to families in need.

at ytre.explanation: "At ytre" means "to express" or "to utter", to say an opinion or a wish out loud. A related word is ytringsfrihed (freedom of speech).

sentence.da: Alle må gerne **ytre** deres mening i et frit land.
sentence.en: Everyone may express their opinion in a free country.

en yderside.explanation: "En yderside" means "an outside", the outer surface of something. The opposite is en inderside (an inside).

sentence.da: Vi maler husets **yderside** i dag.
sentence.en: We are painting the outside of the house today.

en yndlingsbog.explanation: "En yndlingsbog" means "a favorite book". Put yndlings- (favorite) in front of many words: min yndlingsmad (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Jeg har læst min **yndlingsbog** mange gange.
sentence.en: I have read my favorite book many times.

en yndlingsfarve.explanation: "En yndlingsfarve" means "a favorite color". It is built from yndling (favorite) and farve (color). The same works for food: min yndlingsmad (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfarve** er grøn, og min søsters er blå.
sentence.en: My favorite color is green, and my sister's is blue.

en yndlingsfilm.explanation: "En yndlingsfilm" means "a favorite movie". Put yndlings- (favorite) in front of other words the same way: min yndlingsmad (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsfilm** er meget gammel, men jeg elsker den.
sentence.en: My favorite movie is very old, but I love it.

en yndlingsret.explanation: "En yndlingsret" means "a favorite dish". It is built from yndling (favorite) and ret (dish). Ret can also mean a court of law: Han skal for retten (He has to go to court).

sentence.da: Min **yndlingsret** er pandekager med syltetøj.
sentence.en: My favorite dish is pancakes with jam.

en yndlingssang.explanation: "En yndlingssang" means "a favorite song". Yndlings- (favorite) works in front of many words: min yndlingsmad (my favorite food).

sentence.da: Jeg synger min **yndlingssang** i bilen.
sentence.en: I sing my favorite song in the car.

en yogamåtte.explanation: "En yogamåtte" means "a yoga mat", the soft mat you stand or sit on to do yoga. It is built from yoga and måtte (mat).

sentence.da: Hun ruller sin **yogamåtte** ud og laver yoga.
sentence.en: She rolls out her yoga mat and does yoga.

yderligere.explanation: "Yderligere" means "further" and "additional", on top of what is already there. It also works with an action, to say that something goes even further: Priserne steg yderligere (Prices rose even more).

sentence.da: Hvis du har **yderligere** spørgsmål, kan du ringe til os.
sentence.en: If you have further questions, you can call us.

yderst.explanation: "Yderst" means "extremely" and also "outermost", the part farthest out: yderst til venstre (on the far left).

forms.en: at the very end of the line

sentence.da: Det er **yderst** vigtigt, at du kommer til tiden.
sentence.en: It is extremely important that you arrive on time.

ydmyg.explanation: "Ydmyg" means "humble", not acting as if you are better than others, and ready to admit what you do not know. It can also describe simple things: en ydmyg bolig (a humble home).

sentence.da: Vinderen var **ydmyg** og takkede alle, der havde hjulpet hende.
sentence.en: The winner was humble and thanked everyone who had helped her.

ydre.explanation: "Ydre" means "outer", for the part of something that is farthest out. It keeps the same form with every word.

sentence.da: Husets **ydre** mure er hvide.
sentence.en: The outer walls of the house are white.

ymer.explanation: "Ymer" means "a Danish soured milk", thick and sour and usually eaten at breakfast. It is traditionally topped with ymerdrys, a crunchy mix of dried rye bread crumbs and sugar.

sentence.da: **Ymer** er sur og tyk, og man spiser den med en ske.
sentence.en: Ymer is sour and thick, and you eat it with a spoon.

yndlings-.explanation: "Yndlings-" means "favorite" and goes in front of another word to build one: yndlingsmad (favorite food). Write it together with the word: yndlingsbog (favorite book).

sentence.da: Min **yndlings**farve er blå.
sentence.en: My favorite color is blue.

yngre.explanation: "Yngre" means "younger". It is the form of ung (young) you use to compare people.

sentence.da: Min søster er **yngre** end mig.
sentence.en: My sister is younger than me.

yngst.explanation: "Yngst" means "youngest", the one with the lowest age in a group. For two people, use yngre (younger): Jeg er yngre end min bror (I am younger than my brother).

sentence.da: Anna er **yngst** af mine børn.
sentence.en: Anna is the youngest of my children.

ynkelig.explanation: "Ynkelig" means "pathetic", so weak or poor that people feel pity or scorn. It describes a performance, a result or a sight, rather than a feeling inside you.

sentence.da: Det var en **ynkelig** præstation, og holdet tabte stort.
sentence.en: It was a pathetic performance, and the team lost by a lot.

yoga.explanation: "Yoga" means "yoga", exercise with slow movements and calm breathing. To say you do it, use at lave (to do) or at dyrke (to practice).

sentence.da: I **yoga** strækker man sig og trækker vejret dybt.
sentence.en: In yoga, you stretch and breathe deeply.

yoghurt.explanation: "En yoghurt" means "a yogurt", one pot of it. For yogurt as a food, say noget yoghurt (some yogurt).

sentence.da: **Yoghurt** er lavet af mælk.
sentence.en: Yogurt is made of milk.

ytringsfrihed.explanation: "Ytringsfrihed" means "freedom of speech", the right to share your opinion without being punished for it. It is built from en ytring (a statement) and frihed (freedom), and it covers writing and publishing too, not only speaking.

sentence.da: **Ytringsfrihed** betyder, at alle må sige deres mening.
sentence.en: Freedom of speech means that everyone may say what they think.
